audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (1) 25 lint findings: Zoe called he/him across 24 fields (she/her per champ-gender), plus the usual bleed/cooldown defects. (2) 'Golden Eclipse reflects her charged Q' in whys[4], spikes[1], spikes[3] and late — Mel's R does not reflect; the reflect is Rebuttal (W), and Zoe's Q is projectile-flagged so W genuinely reflects it.
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js lists zoe female; kit texts define which ability reflects. Sleepy Trouble Bubble carries hardCC+trueDamage+terrain flags — the doubled wake-up hit ignores resists, and the bubble can wall a retreat.
audit.corrected: Every flagged pronoun fixed; every R-reflect claim moved to Rebuttal.

audit.why: Trade guidance (hold W and E purely defensively pre-item, punish the 18s bubble downtime) is kit-true.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits (lint), and dosFull[2].d said 'fifteen-second invitation' for an 18s ability.
audit.why: Sleepy Trouble Bubble 18/17/16/15/14s; Paddle Star 8.5s rank 1; Mel W 38s, E 11s.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with real numbers; 15 corrected to 18.

audit.why: Wave text serviceable after pronoun fixes.

edits.before: Two items plus the matchup is yours. Zoe is a squishy one-combo picker with no reliable escape once her R and E are down, so in grouped fights you flank, snare, and reflect her charged Q with Golden Eclipse. She still one-shots a caught carry, so peel with E for your team — but in a straight fight where you dodge the bubble, your sustained damage and reflect out-value her single burst window.

notes: All 25 lint findings addressed: 24 he/him references to Zoe (she/her) fixed with minimal pronoun swaps — seven of those live in report[N].t; they are one-word gender corrections, not rewrites, done because the sweep exemption for report[] does not cover lint-flagged defects. R-reflect fabrication fixed in four places (Rebuttal reflects, Golden Eclipse executes).
